subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous runtime object and helper layer: server track-signal dispatch and network replay buffer initialization, a COM-style transport interface pattern at obj+0x3FB8, flag-guarded and bitfield control objects, camera/position-heading per-frame update controllers, linked-list containers and a recursive merge sort, career stats-page list rebuild, FTIM timer overlay string assembly, and session/UI factory driven initialization and multiplayer join handling.

summary: Twenty-eight generic runtime objects and helpers. ServerCloseTrackSignal (0x00461020) encodes a progress-bar event, dispatches a network message through the +0x3FB8 interface, clears the session open flag at +0x29 and appends a debug-log node to the list at +0x1B770..+0x1B77C gated on logging global 0x007D0398; DispatchServerTrackSignal (0x00463760) gates that dispatch on a state check. NetworkReplayBufferInit (0x0045D260) seeds a replay buffer control object with the session port, XOR-decodes an obfuscation key and allocates a network memory object. A COM-style transport interface at obj+0x3FB8 is shared across 0x0045E570, 0x00461020, 0x00462760, 0x00462A00 and 0x00463140 (GUESS). PositionUpdateWithHeadingAndVelocity (0x00466350) and SteeringOrRotationUpdate (0x00466650) are per-frame position/heading updates sharing a field layout (+0x40 sub-object, +0x104/+0x108 saved position, flag +0xF4, closing vtable+44 call) and are grouped as CameraYawZoomController (GUESS). InitDefaults (0x00461560) and BitFlagTestAt0x6E (0x004615F0) share the +0x6E byte region and are grouped as ScenarioValidationBuffer. HTMLResultsStatsPageWorldChampionships (0x00468910) rebuilds a stat-entry linked list (node data+0/next+4), FTIMTimerBitmapSelector (0x0046B5F0) builds an FTIM overlay string, SessionStateHandler (0x0046DC60) and MultiplayerPasswordValidation (0x0046DD30) share a UI factory at +0x40 (vtable+0x1C). The remaining functions are isolated flag/pointer/list helpers. All packet owners are UnknownObject; every class here is DERIVED/GUESS synthesis.

classes.name: DelimitedStringAssembler
classes.responsibility: Appends two input strings through a shared transform (ShortComputation_cf30) into a caller buffer, separated by the read-only 16-bit global word_5C2AAC, returning the appended length.

classes.name: FlaggedSocketCleanupController
classes.responsibility: Conditional one-byte flag reset that runs two cleanup wrappers (single-call wrapper and socket close) only while the flag at this+0 is set, then clears it.

classes.name: NetworkReplayBufferController
classes.responsibility: Initializes a replay/network buffer-control object: stores the session port twice, clears an active flag, zeroes and XOR-decodes an obfuscation key, then allocates a network memory object via MemoryObjectAllocator with a callback and stores its handle.

classes.name: ConditionalAnimationController
classes.responsibility: Flag-gated animation timing update: when the byte at this+0x20 is clear, forwards the parameter-set pointer at this+0x3FB8 to the shared animation timing update and returns its result, else returns the flag value.

classes.name: SentinelBufferInitializer
classes.responsibility: Fills a 0x1A0-byte buffer at this+0x1D4 with 0xFF bytes (every word becomes 0xFFFFFFFF / -1) and always returns -1; used on setup paths to pre-fill per-object slot/ID buffers with unset values.

classes.name: ServerTrackSignalObject
classes.responsibility: Server session track-signal sink: encodes a progress-bar event, allocates/dispatches a network message through the interface at +0x3FB8, clears the open flag at +0x29, and appends a debug-log node to the list at +0x1B770..+0x1B77C gated on the logging global, else frees it.

classes.name: ServerTrackSignalDispatcher
classes.responsibility: State-gated dispatch of the server track signal: runs a state check on the wrapper, forwards the dereferenced this+0 target to ServerOpenedClosedNotification on failure, or to ServerOpenTrackSignal / ServerCloseTrackSignal based on a2.

classes.name: BitFieldFlagController
classes.responsibility: Sets or clears a caller-selected bit mask in the byte bitfield at this+0x88, returning the mask on the set path and the updated field on the clear path.

classes.name: ScenarioValidationBuffer
classes.responsibility: Small control/flag object written by InitDefaults and queried by BitFlagTestAt0x6E: a set of zeroed bytes/words, a cluster of non-zero control defaults (+0x66..+0x6A), a 16-bit limit at +0x7C and a per-bit flag byte at +0x6E.

classes.name: ServerListController
classes.responsibility: Server-list sort/filter entry point: dereferences the server-list object, guards on a network-system pointer, marks sort-as-changed, clamps and stores the requested sort index into globals, and dispatches a sort-key string while raising a refresh flag.

classes.name: EntrantCountReader
classes.responsibility: Dereferences this+0 and returns the DWORD field at obj+0x3E14, interpreted as the driver/entrant count by network and session scoring paths (DERIVED label; raw source proves only the read).

classes.name: VTableBoolCheckNegated
classes.responsibility: Thin wrapper returning the negation of a vtable-dispatched boolean test (VTableBoolCheck with selector literal 140), returning true only when the dispatched test yields zero.

classes.name: BufferSendWithLocks
classes.responsibility: Sends a 128-byte caller buffer through a COM-style temporary object: query, lock (vtable+0xc4), copy, unlock (virtual dispatch), release (vtable+0x7c), always returning 1.

classes.name: ChainedFlagReader
classes.responsibility: Accessor following a multi-level pointer chain (this+0 vtable, obj+0x3FB8 intermediate, its first slot) to return the byte at offset 0x5D of the final object; no guard.

classes.name: VirtualDispatchStateController
classes.responsibility: Unconditional dual virtual dispatch on a sub-object at obj+0x3FB8, then writes 0 to the state field at obj+0x3FC4 and returns the dispatch result.

classes.name: TargetStringFieldWriter
classes.responsibility: Copies a caller string into a fixed 32-byte buffer at obj+0x1B0 of the target object held at this+0 (bound 31 chars, forced NUL at +0x1CF), or writes an empty string when the source is null.

classes.name: NonEmptyStringAccessor
classes.responsibility: Getter that returns the string pointer at obj+364 (obj from this+0) only when strlen reports a non-empty string, else null.

classes.name: FlaggedPointerOwner
classes.responsibility: Destructor-like conditional free: frees the embedded pointer at this+0 when the flag at this+0x8 is set, and frees the object itself when parameter bit 0 is set; returns this unchanged.

classes.name: LinkedListMergeSorter
classes.responsibility: Recursive merge sort for a singly-linked list whose nodes link via the next pointer at +4: counts nodes, splits at the midpoint, recurses, then merges by comparing a sort key at each node's record (+8, falling back to +0 when the key is -1).

classes.name: FractionalAccumulatorDistributor
classes.responsibility: Accumulates a float input at this+0x68, converts to the integer part, iterates 104 records (560-byte stride from this+35) calling sub_464B10 with it, then stores the fractional remainder back.

classes.name: StateResetHelper
classes.responsibility: State-reset helper that releases attached resources via ResourceCleanup, zeroes the dword at this+0xF0, and returns 1 as a success indicator.

classes.name: CameraYawZoomController
classes.responsibility: Per-frame position/heading update controller with two variants: guarded by a dword at +0xEC/+0xF0, reads saved-position components through a sub-object at +0x40, computes deltas, applies flag-based speed/brake and heading-angle branches (clamped/wrapped under the photo/free-camera global), resolves velocity from heading/speed and ends with a vtable+44 virtual call; the brake/reset variant additionally accumulates elapsed time at +0x10C and a correction term at +0x110.

classes.name: HTMLResultsStatsPage
classes.responsibility: Career-mode World Championships results page reset: walks and frees the stat-entry linked list (head +0x44, tail +0x48, count +0x4C, capacity +0x50), clears the list bookkeeping, then repopulates it with ten career stat label strings inserted with key -1.

classes.name: StatListNode
classes.responsibility: Referenced node layout of the stat-entry linked list held by HTMLResultsStatsPage: a data pointer at +0 and a next pointer at +4, with a presence flag byte at +8 (prose-only, not a promoted field).

classes.name: FTIMTimerDisplayStringBuilder
classes.responsibility: Builds the composite display string for an FTIM timer overlay entry: fetches the active vehicle pointer by index, formats lap count and total/current lap pair with session-type awareness, copies driver/vehicle name strings, selects an outline color string, and concatenates up to six component buffers separated by a delimiter, filtered by this+0x17C.

classes.name: SessionUIScreenController
classes.responsibility: Session/game-mode initialization and multiplayer join handling sharing a UI-object factory interface at this+0x40 (vtable+0x1C element creation): initializes the session-type flag, performs formation-lap UI/force-feedback setup and validation, and drives the multiplayer password/join flow with a 4.0f result timer at this+0xE4.

interfaces.name: ITransportComInterface
interfaces.purpose: COM-style transport interface located at obj/this+0x3FB8 and shared across five packet functions: an animation parameter set (0x0045E570), network message allocation/dispatch and commit (0x00461020), a temporary-object lock/copy/unlock/release (0x00462760), the root of a pointer chain to a flag byte (0x00462A00), and a dual virtual dispatch target with a state reset (0x00463140). Whether these five share one interface type is GUESS; only the +0x3FB8 location is evidenced.

interfaces.name: ISessionUIObjectFactory
interfaces.purpose: UI-object factory interface at this+0x40 whose vtable slot +0x1C creates UI elements by ID (30 in session initialization, 34 in multiplayer password validation). Shared ownership is GUESS; the slot and the element IDs are packet evidence.

compatibility_contracts.name: ServerTrackSignalContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The server session must preserve the observable close-track signal behavior of 0x00461020: a progress-bar event is encoded (ProgressBarEventEncode(4, 37, 0, 255, low dword of dbl_8AFEA0, 1)), a network message object is allocated and flagged active through the +0x3FB8 interface, dispatched via NetworkSendDispatch, committed through the COM virtual method, and the session open/close flag at +0x29 is cleared.

compatibility_contracts.name: DebugLogListHeaderContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The debug-log linked list held by the server session object uses a four-slot header at +0x1B770 (head), +0x1B774 (tail), +0x1B778 (secondary) and +0x1B77C (node count); the previous tail's +4 slot is linked to each appended node, and the append is gated on the logging-enabled global 0x007D0398 (non-zero appends, zero frees the node and its string buffer).

compatibility_contracts.name: ComInterfaceAt3FB8Contract
compatibility_contracts.description: Several runtime objects locate a COM-style interface pointer at byte offset 0x3FB8 (this or obj base): 0x0045E570 forwards it as a parameter set, 0x00461020 allocates/dispatches network messages through it, 0x00462760 queries a temporary object from it and locks/copies/unlocks/releases via vtable offsets 0xc4/0x7c, 0x00462A00 walks its pointer chain, and 0x00463140 dispatches through it and resets a state field at +0x3FC4. Whether all five share one interface type is unresolved.

compatibility_contracts.name: CameraControllerFieldContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The two per-frame update variants (0x00466350, 0x00466650) share a field layout: a sub-object pointer at +0x40 read through FloatFieldAccessor/DualFieldRead, saved-position components at +0x104/+0x108, a branch flag at +0xF4, a guard dword at +0xEC/+0xF0, and a closing virtual call through vtable+44 on the vtable pointer at +0x0. Common class ownership is GUESS.

compatibility_contracts.name: StatListLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The career stat-entry list managed by 0x00468910 uses page bookkeeping at +0x44 (head), +0x48 (tail), +0x4C (count) and +0x50 (capacity) over nodes with a data pointer at +0 and a next pointer at +4; nodes and their data buffers are freed through FreeWrapper_7bcf and ten labels are inserted with key -1 via 0x00486F30.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionUIFactoryContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The session object exposes a UI-object factory at this+0x40 whose vtable slot +0x1C creates UI elements by id: 30 (formation-lap race setup in 0x0046DC60) and 34 (multiplayer password entry in 0x0046DD30). The factory object's vtable sits at +0x0 of the +0x40 pointer. Shared ownership is GUESS.

The meaning of the non-zero InitDefaults values (+0x66 = 16, +0x67 = 1, +0x68 = 1, +0x69 = 100, +0x6A = 1, +0x7C = 200) is unknown; no consuming code is visible in this packet.
